name: python-bloom-filter
title: Membership tests whose error rate you can measure
blurb: A Bloom filter sized from the math (bits = -n ln p / ln2^2, hashes = bits/n ln2), with the one guarantee it really has proved by testing every added item, and the false-positive rate measured against the formula at three budgets. The k sweep shows why more hashes stop helping, removal by clearing bits breaks the guarantee for a second item (shown failing), and the counting filter with saturating byte counters is the way back. Saturation is reported instead of hidden: info exits non-zero once the filter answers yes to nearly everything.
default_description: Bit-array membership sized from the math, with the measured false-positive rate and a removal that cannot lie.
